name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.buildList_getD
typeText:
∀ {α : Type} (step : List.{0} α → Nat → α) (n j : Nat),
  LT.lt.{0} j n →
    ∀ (d : α),
      Eq.{1} (List.getD.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.buildList step n) j d)
        (step (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.buildList step j) j)

source.code:
theorem buildList_getD (step : List α → ℕ → α) (n j : ℕ) (hj : j < n) (d : α) :
    (buildList step n).getD j d = step (buildList step j) j := by
  induction n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [buildList_succ]
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j n with h | h
      · rw [List.getD_append _ _ _ _ (by rw [buildList_length]; exact h)]
        exact ih h
      · have hjn : j = n := by omega
        subst hjn
        rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_append_right (by rw [buildList_length])]
        simp [buildList_length]
